# ♆ mikymaione.it
This repository contains the source code for [mikymaione.github.io](https://mikymaione.github.io/), a personal portfolio hosted on GitHub Pages that showcases my software projects and games.

## 🛠️ Technology Stack
- **Static Site Generator:** [Jekyll](https://jekyllrb.com/);
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages;
- **Environment:** Developed using Ruby and Bundler.

## 🚀 Local Development
To run this project locally:

1. Install Jekyll and Bundler:
```bash
gem install jekyll bundler
```

2. Install project gems:
```bash
bundle install
```

3. Start the local server:
```bash
bundle exec jekyll serve
```
